title: ClickHouse Query & Ingestion Workload
subtitle: What the cluster has been doing over the trailing window, grouped by normalized query shape. SQL text is redacted in the sandbox; the shape hash and the real tables each shape touches are preserved, so the workload reads clearly without exposing any literal.

panels.text:
## Reading the real queries — with the values stripped
Each shape is ranked by cost and shown as a real query via `normalizeQuery()`: table and column names are kept, every **literal value is replaced with `?`** (the part that could carry data). In the LLM's anonymized copy the `query` column is fully redacted; this report renders against the de-anonymized system, so you read the actual SQL shape — `SELECT … FROM real.table WHERE col = ?` — without exposing a single literal. Inserts and async-insert flushes are split out because they dominate write-heavy clusters.

panels.query: SELECT count() AS finished, countIf(query_kind = 'Select') AS selects, countIf(query_kind IN ('Insert', 'AsyncInsertFlush')) AS inserts, round(avg(query_duration_ms)) AS avg_ms, round(quantile(0.99)(query_duration_ms)) AS p99_ms FROM system_anon.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND event_time > now() - 86400

panels.title: Query volume by hour
panels.query: SELECT toStartOfHour(event_time) AS hour, countIf(query_kind = 'Select') AS selects, countIf(query_kind IN ('Insert', 'AsyncInsertFlush')) AS inserts, countIf(exception_code != 0) AS failed FROM system_anon.query_log WHERE type IN ('QueryFinish', 'ExceptionWhileProcessing', 'ExceptionBeforeStart') AND event_time > now() - 86400 GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

panels.title: Heaviest query shapes (by total read rows)
panels.query: SELECT any(query_kind) AS kind, count() AS runs, sum(read_rows) AS total_rows_read, round(avg(query_duration_ms)) AS avg_ms, any(normalizeQuery(query)) AS example_query FROM system_anon.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND event_time > now() - 86400 GROUP BY normalized_query_hash ORDER BY total_rows_read DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT any(query_kind) AS kind, count() AS runs, sum(read_rows) AS total_rows_read, arrayStringConcat(arraySlice(arrayDistinct(arrayFlatten(groupArray(tables))), 1, 3), ', ') AS tables_touched FROM system_anon.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND event_time > now() - 86400 GROUP BY normalized_query_hash ORDER BY total_rows_read DESC LIMIT 3

panels.title: Where the read work goes
panels.template: A **{{kind}}** shape ran {{runs|num}} times and read **{{total_rows_read|num!}}** rows, touching `{{tables_touched}}`. If that is more rows than the result justifies, it is the first candidate for an index or projection review.
